reference_sql:
WITH starts AS (
  -- one row per session_start event with both IDs on the Dublin day 4 November 2025
  SELECT user_pseudo_id,
    list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value AS ga_session_id
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start'
    AND event_date = '20251104'
    AND user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL
), joined AS (
  -- one row per match between an event and a backend session: the same visitor and the same start second
  SELECT st.user_pseudo_id, s.session_id
  FROM starts st
  JOIN sessions s ON s.visitor_id = st.user_pseudo_id
    AND epoch(s.session_start) = st.ga_session_id
)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM starts) AS events_before,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM joined) AS rows_after,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM joined) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM starts) AS difference

solver.query:
WITH starts AS (
  SELECT user_pseudo_id,
    list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value AS ga_session_id
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start'
    AND event_date = '20251104'
    AND user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL
), ev AS (
  SELECT * FROM starts WHERE ga_session_id IS NOT NULL
), s AS (
  SELECT visitor_id, CAST(floor(epoch(session_start)) AS BIGINT) AS start_sec
  FROM sessions
  WHERE session_start >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-11-03 00:00:00+00'
    AND session_start < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-11-06 00:00:00+00'
), j AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM ev JOIN s ON s.visitor_id = ev.user_pseudo_id AND s.start_sec = ev.ga_session_id
)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ev) AS events_before,
  j.n AS rows_after,
  j.n - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ev) AS difference
FROM j
